title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 448 (Punishment for false statement)

content.overview: A person who makes a statement that is false in a material particular, knowing it to be false, or omits a material fact knowing it to be material, in a return, report, certificate or other document, is punishable under section 447.
content.glance: A person who makes a statement that is false in a material particular, knowing it to be false, or omits a material fact knowing it to be material, in a return, report, certificate or other document, is punishable under section 447.
content.study: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 448 (Punishment for false statement). A person who makes a statement that is false in a material particular, knowing it to be false, or omits a material fact knowing it to be material, in a return, report, certificate or other document, is punishable under section 447. Apply only the conditions, approvals, filings and penalties stated in the section. A rule made under the Act cannot contradict the section. Not a verified closure.
